text: {"1668":{"about":["rustc_codegen_llvm"],"refers":[],"why":"The LLVM codegen backend delegates backend implementation work to LLVM rather than implementing it all in rustc."},"1669":{"about":[],"refers":[],"why":"This is a general statement about the project-level maintenance benefit of using LLVM."},"1670":{"about":["rustc_codegen_llvm"],"refers":[],"why":"The LLVM backend obtains LLVM's optimization capabilities when lowering Rust code to LLVM IR and machine code."},"1671":{"about":["rustc_codegen_llvm"],"refers":[],"why":"The LLVM backend provides Rust access to the targets supported by LLVM."},"1672":{"about":["rustc_codegen_llvm"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc's ability to compile to wasm following LLVM target support is enabled by its LLVM codegen backend."}}
